Named partners and projects (Sharon AI, Firmus Batam campus of up to 170,000 GPUs and 360 MW expected scale) are described by NVIDIA and quoted executives, with no independent confirmation. Material unknowns: the revenue-share percentage, the size and form of credit support, which capacity qualifies as supported, the contract terms and accounting, how much of the model is already deployed versus planned, and whether the Firmus figures are firm commitments or targets. Evidence needed: NVIDIA filings or call disclosure quantifying the share and credit-support exposure, customer or AI cloud disclosures of contracted volumes, financing or guarantee documents, and later quarters showing revenue and receivables tied to these arrangements.
